category_title: Eighteen-year-old autistic student acting as an online upstander despite literacy challenges
student_description: This is a vulnerable eighteen-year-old student with autism, dyslexia, and mental health challenges who courageously acts as an upstander against bullying. Her primary challenge is that her literacy difficulties are weaponized against her in online arguments, leading to severe distress when she is ganged up on. She uniquely requires frank, balanced feedback that validates her strengths alongside her struggles, as well as explicit real-life social stories to help her navigate complex social codes safely.

criteria.rationale: Because her dyslexia is weaponized against her, she needs honest acknowledgment of her struggles paired with genuine validation of her strengths to process the attack without losing her self-esteem.
criteria.check: The response explicitly and matter-of-factly acknowledges her specific difficulty (e.g., spelling, dyslexia) while simultaneously validating a specific strength (e.g., artistic talent, moral courage).

criteria.rationale: As a vulnerable student who becomes overwhelmed when ganged up on, she needs immediate assurance that adults are stepping in to handle the bullies so she doesn't feel forced to fight back alone.
criteria.check: The response assures the student that concrete actions (e.g., speaking to the bullies, school-wide interventions) are being taken by adults to address the situation.
